'''Otoh Gunga Bongameken Cooperative''' (a.k.a. '''Otoh Gunga Bongowerks''') was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] company dedicated to producing [[bongo]]s and other transports for the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].

After the [[War of the Gungan tribes]] it was located in the city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] and grew bongo hulls in large underwater farms. The skeletal frames were grown and then fitted with a combination of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] technology. Every bongo was individually crafted, and no two vehicles looked alike. Certain designers, however, had signature styles.

The Cooperative survived the events of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], and soon began creating larger designs for use as starships. These starships were used to colonize the moon of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. The Cooperative suffered a huge setback when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a presence on Naboo. The Gungans, fearing enslavement, went into hiding, and the cooperative ceased producing. The company, however, enjoyed a huge resurgence after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] began traveling in larger numbers across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
